examples.text: ñātikāya aññātikasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñātikāya vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

28901.meaning1: perceiving as related; regarding (someone) as a relative

examples.text: ñātake vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñātake ñātakasaññī, anāpatti.

28902.meaning1: certain well known; one of the famous

examples.text: sace me samaṇo gotamo tathā patiṭṭhissati yathā ca me ñāt'aññatarena sāvakena assajinā nāma bhikkhunā patiṭṭhitaṃ… evam'ev'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi.
abhijānāti no, bhante, bhagavā ahu ñāt'aññatarassa mahesakkhassa yakkhassa saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ bhāsitā'ti?

28903.meaning1: fact of being well known; celebrity

examples.text: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi ñāto yasassī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appaññātā app'esakkhā'ti. so tena ñātattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.

28904.meaning1: complete comprehension through what is known
28904.commentary: (NIDD1a) tattha katamā ñātapariññā? sabbadhammaṃ jānāti ime ajjhattikā, ime bāhirā, idam'assa lakkhaṇaṃ, imāni rasa-paccupaṭṭhāna-padaṭṭhānānī'ti, ayaṃ ñātapariññā.

examples.text: phassaṃ pariññāyā'ti phassaṃ tīhi pariññāhi parijānitvā, ñātapariññāya, tīraṇapariññāya, pahānapariññāya. katamā ñātapariññā?

28905.meaning1: should be known as; should be understood as

examples.text: ekacco hi, pañhaṃ pucchissāmī'ti kaṇṭhaṃ sodheti, so itarena, idaṃ nāma tvaṃ pucchissasī'ti vutto ñātabhāvaṃ ñatvā, na etaṃ, aññaṃ pucchissāmī'ti vadati.
anuviccakāraṃ kho, gahapati, karohi, anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotī'ti.
ārogyaparamā lābhā, santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñāti, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.
ye me petā ñātī sālohitā kālaṅ'katā pasannacittā anussaranti tesaṃ taṃ mahapphalaṃ assa mah'ānisaṃsan'ti

28911.meaning1: talk about family; discussion about relatives

examples.text: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mah'āmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ

28912.meaning1: perceiving as related; regarding (someone) as a relative

examples.text: ñātikāya vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñātikāya ñātikasaññī, anāpatti.

anāpatti ñātikāya, pārivattakaṃ parittena vā vipulaṃ, vipulena vā parittaṃ, bhikkhunī vissāsaṃ gaṇhāti, tāvakālikaṃ gaṇhāti, cīvaraṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ deti, sikkhamānāya, sāmaṇeriyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

28915.meaning1: who wants a family; who wishes for relatives

examples.text: tvaññ'eva no ñāti ñātikāmānaṃ, tvaṃ pana bhattā bhattukāmānaṃ.

28916.meaning1: household; family home; family and relatives
28916.commentary: (ANa) sakāni vā ñātikulānī'ti attano yāpanamattaṃ dhanaṃ gahetvā ñātigharāni gacchatu.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imissā'y'eva sāvatthiyā aññatarā itthī ñātikulaṃ agamāsi. tassā te ñātakā sāmikaṃ acchinditvā aññassa dātu'kāmā.
yā icchati sā idh'eva bhoge ca bhuñjatu puññāni ca karotu, sakāni vā ñātikulāni gacchatu. hoti vā pana puris'ādhippāyo, kassa vo dammī'ti?

28917.meaning1: loss of relatives; destruction of family

examples.text: atha kho tesaṃ, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati, mayaṃ kho akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu evarūpaṃ āyataṃ ñātikkhayaṃ pattā. yaṃnūna mayaṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma.

28918.meaning1: relatives home; house of a relation

28919.commentary: (VINa) ñātakehi me cīvar'atthāya pesitaṃ, mittehi pesitaṃ, te āgatā cīvare dassantī'ti evaṃ ñātito vā mittato vā paccāsā hoti.

examples.text: uppajjeyyā'ti uppajjeyya saṅghato vā gaṇato vā ñātito vā mittato vā paṃsukūlaṃ vā attano vā dhanena.

tena kho pana samayena āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa ñātidāsī ābhidosikaṃ kummāsaṃ chaḍḍetu'kāmā hoti. atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo taṃ ñātidāsiṃ etadavoca, sac'etaṃ, bhagini, chaḍḍanīyadhammaṃ, idha me patte ākirā'ti.
so ñātidhammo ca ayaṃ nidassito, petāna'pūjā ca katā uḷārā, balañ'ca bhikkhūnam'anuppadinnaṃ, tumhehi puññaṃ pasutaṃ anappakan'ti.
so kho ahaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena… appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.

28923.meaning1: loss of relatives; decline in kin

examples.text: appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, parihāni yadidaṃ ñātiparihāni. etaṃ patikiṭṭhaṃ, bhikkhave, parihānīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāparihānī'ti.

28924.meaning1: degradation of relatives; deterioration of family

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bho raṭṭhapāla, ñātipārijuññaṃ? idha, bho raṭṭhapāla, ekaccassa bahū honti mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā. tassa te ñātakā anupubbena parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.

katamāni pañca? rūpabalaṃ, bhogabalaṃ, ñātibalaṃ, puttabalaṃ, sīlabalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṃ ajjhāvasatī'ti.

28927.meaning1: because of the power of relatives

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalahetu vā bhogabalahetu vā ñātibalahetu vā puttabalahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. sīlabalahetu kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.

puna caparaṃ, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sed'āvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi pañcabaliṃ kattā hoti, ñātibaliṃ, atithibaliṃ, pubbapetabaliṃ, rājabaliṃ, devatābaliṃ. idam'assa tatiyaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno na iti paṭisañcikkhati, tathābhūto kho ayaṃ lokasannivāso tathābhūto ayaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho
ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa

28930.meaning1: because of loss of relatives; due to loss of family

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, sattā ñātibyasanahetu vā bhogabyasanahetu vā rogabyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.

28931.meaning1: among one's relatives; in the midst of family

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho

28932.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of ñātimajjha
28932.meaning1: among one's relatives; in the midst of family
28932.commentary: (SNa) ñātimajjhe virocatī'ti ñātigaṇamajjhe saṃkiccatherassa saddhivihāriko adhimuttakasāmaṇero viya sobhati.

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, ñātimajjhe virocatī'ti.
cirappavāsiṃ purisaṃ, dūrato sotthim'āgataṃ, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, abhinandanti āgataṃ.
kodhasammadasammatto, āyasakyaṃ nigacchati, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, parivajjanti kodhanaṃ.
yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi

28936.meaning1: group of relatives; circle of kin

examples.text: bahūni puttasatāni, ñātisaṅghasatāni ca, khāditāni atīt'aṃse, mama tuyhañ'ca brāhmaṇa.

28938.meaning1: successful attainment of relatives; having a big family
28938.commentary: (DNa) ñātisampadā'ti ñātīnaṃ sampadā pāripūrī bahubhāvo. bhogasampadāya'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: pañca sampadā, ñātisampadā, bhogasampadā, ārogyasampadā, sīlasampadā, diṭṭhisampadā. n'āvuso, sattā ñātisampadāhetu vā bhogasampadāhetu vā ārogyasampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.

28939.meaning1: because of the having lots of relatives

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, sattā ñātisampadāhetu vā bhogasampadāhetu vā ārogyasampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. sīlasampadāhetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
labheyya nu kho so coro coraghātesu, āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā, amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, yāv'āhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī'ti

tam'enaṃ mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā jātam'eva naṃ saṅghāṭikaṃ kareyyuṃ, saṅghāṭikattam'eva samādapeyyuṃ, ehi tvaṃ, bhadramukha, saṅghāṭiko hohi, saṅghāṭikassa te sato saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena abhijjhālussa abhijjhā pahīyissati

28941.meaning1: obligation to family and blood relatives; responsibility to kin and blood

examples.text: kuto, bho sāriputta, amhākaṃ appamādo yesaṃ no… mitt'āmaccānaṃ mitt'āmaccakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ñātisālohitānaṃ ñātisālohitakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, atithīnaṃ atithikaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, pubbapetānaṃ pubbapetakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, devatānaṃ devatākaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, rañño rājakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo'ti?

28942.meaning1: most important relative; foremost family member
28942.meaning2: most important relative; foremost family member

examples.text: atha kho kapilavatthuvāsī sakyā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ, bhagavā amhākaṃ ñātiseṭṭho, mayam'pi arahāma bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayam'pi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ'ca mahañ'ca karissāmā'ti.

28943.commentary: (ANa) amhākaṃ ñātakā bahū puññavantā'ti-ādinā nayena ñātake ārabbha uppanno vitakko ñātivitakko

examples.text: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno sukhumasahagatā upakkilesā ñātivitakko janapadavitakko anavaññattipaṭisaṃyutto vitakko
vihiṃsāvitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ ñātivitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ janapadavitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ

28944.meaning1: growth of relatives; increase in kin

examples.text: appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, vuddhi yadidaṃ ñātivuddhi. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, vuddhīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāvuddhi.
sakkā pan'etaṃ, bhante, mayā ñātuṃ, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti?
yattha nu kho, bhante, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, sakkā nu kho so, bhante, gamanena lokassa anto ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vā'ti?

28947.meaning1: could be known; could be understood; knowable; cognizable (by)

examples.text: yattha kho, āvuso, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, n'āhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyan'ti vadāmī'ti.
yathā yathā vā pana taṃ ñāteyyaṃ vā daṭṭheyyaṃ vā sacchikareyyaṃ vā, tathā tathā ñassati vā dakkhati vā sacchikarissati vā'ti ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.
[aṭṭhakathāṭīkāsu ca ayam'ev'attho ñāpito]
evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, vūpasametabbaṃ. sabbeh'eva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitabbaṃ, sannipatitvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo.
ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena sako pakkho ñāpetabbo.

28953.meaning2: to inform; to announce; to make known

28957.synonym: ākāra, upāya, niyāma, nīhāra, pakāra, patha, magga, vidhi

examples.text: ek'āyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā

rakkhass'etaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, vācaṃ, rakkhass'etaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, vācaṃ. bahū hi tassa bhoto gotamassa khattiyapaṇḍitā'pi brāhmaṇapaṇḍitā'pi gahapatipaṇḍitā'pi samaṇapaṇḍitā'pi abhippasannā vinītā ariye ñāye dhamme kusale'ti.

28958.meaning1: is known; is evident; is perceived

examples.text: kenassu nappakāsatī'ti kena loko nappakāsati na bhāsati na tapati na virocati na ñāyati na paññāyatī'ti, kenassu nappakāsati.
tath'ev'ime catubbaṇṇā, pabbajitvā tav'antike, jahanti purimaṃ nāmaṃ, buddhaputtā'ti ñāyare.

28959.grammar: pr, pass of jānāti, impers, intrans

28960.commentary: (DNa) apic'ettha ñāyappaṭipanno'ti kāraṇappaṭipanno. (VISM) ñāyo vuccati nibbānaṃ. tadatthāya paṭipannattā ñāyappaṭipanno

examples.text: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ujupaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ñāyapaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho sāmīcipaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho
saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujuppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyappaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcippaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho
sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu! app'iccho so, bhikkhu, kulaputto. sante'y'eva attani kusaladhamme na icchati parehi ñāyamāne.

28963.meaning1: succeeds with the method; accomplishes the system

examples.text: iti kho, cunda, satthā'pi tattha gārayho, dhammo'pi tattha gārayho, sāvako'pi tattha evaṃ gārayho. yo kho, cunda, evarūpaṃ sāvakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya, addhāyasmā ñāyappaṭipanno ñāyam'ārādhessatī'ti. yo ca pasaṃsati, yañ'ca pasaṃsati, yo ca pasaṃsito bhiyyoso mattāya vīriyaṃ ārabhati.

28964.grammar: pr, reflx 3rd pl of ñāyati, pass, intrans

examples.text: tath'ev'ime catubbaṇṇā, pabbajitvā tav'antike, jahanti purimaṃ nāmaṃ, buddhaputtā'ti ñāyare.
bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.

28966.meaning1: should be known; should be understood
28966.meaning2: what should be understood, what can be known

28967.meaning1: which should be known; which should be understood
28967.meaning2: anything that should be learnt or understood

28968.commentary: (DNa) pakataññū'ti ciṇṇavasitāya pakatiṃ sabhāvaṃ jānātī'ti pakataññū. (DNa) tattha suttageyy'ādikaṃ dhammaṃ jānātī'ti dhammaññū. (DNa) tassa tass'eva bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānātī'ti atthaññū. (DNa) paṭiggahaṇaparibhogesu mattaṃ jānātī'ti mattaññū. (DNa) ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa adhigamāyā'ti evaṃ kālaṃ jānātī'ti kālaññū.

examples.text: yathā'pi nāvaṃ daḷham'āruhitvā, phiyena rittena samaṅgibhūto, so tāraye tattha bahū'pi aññe, tatr'ūpayaññū kusalo mutīmā.
varo varaññū varado var'āharo, anuttaro dhammavaraṃ adesayi, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

28970.meaning1: (comm) stone slab mounted on four stone pillars
28970.meaning2: kind of platform or couch; (chiseled) stone platform?
28970.commentary: (SNa) ṭaṅkitamañce'ti dīghamañce pādamajjhe vijjhitvā aṭaniyo pavesetvā katamañce. tassa idaṃ upari, idaṃ heṭṭhā'ti n'atthi, parivattetvā atthato'pi tādiso'va hoti, taṃ devaṭṭhāne ṭhapenti. catunnaṃ pāsāṇānaṃ upari pāsāṇaṃ attharitvā katageham'pi ṭaṅkitamañco'ti vuccati. (SNPa) ṭaṅkitamañco'ti catunnaṃ pāsāṇānaṃ upari vitthataṃ pāsāṇaṃ āropetvā kato pāsāṇamañco.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā gayāyaṃ viharati ṭaṅkitamañce sūcilomassa yakkhassa bhavane.

28971.meaning1: (gram) ṭ-series; group of retroflex consonants beginning with the letter ṭ (ṭ, ṭh, ḍ, ḍh, ṇ)

examples.text: a kavagga hā kaṇṭhajā, i cavagga yā tālujā, u pavaggā oṭṭhajā, ṭavagga ra ḷā muddhajā, tavagga la sā dantajā, e kaṇṭhatālujo, o kaṇṭh'oṭṭhajo, vo dant'oṭṭhajo.
sukhaṃ [so sukhaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) ma. ni. 3.364 aṭṭhakathāṭīkā oloketabbā] ce vedanaṃ vedayati, visaṃyutto naṃ vedayati.
daḷhadhammo (bahūsu) ṭīkā ca moggallānabyākaraṇaṃ ca oloketabbaṃ
thalaṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ thale nikkhittaṃ hoti.
kesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, sadā puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā, ke janā saggagāmino'ti.

28979.meaning1: standing; staying; remaining; living (in or on)
28979.meaning2: that stands on, that remains as a fixture, that lasts
28979.synonym: ajjhāvasanta, ṭha, ṭhāyī, nivāsa, nivāsī, vasī, vāsaka, vāsūpagata

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nigaṇṭhā isigilipasse kāḷasilāyaṃ ubbhaṭṭhakā honti āsanapaṭikkhittā, opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti.

tattha nāgā yojanikāni chatt'ātichattāni ukkhipiṃsu. evaṃ heṭṭhā nāgā bhūmitale rukkhagacchapabbat'ādīsu bhūmaṭṭhakā devatā, antalikkhe ākāsaṭṭhadevā'ti nāgabhavanaṃ ādiṃ katvā cakkavāḷapariyantena yāva brahmalokā chatt'ātichattāni ussāpitāni ahesuṃ.

28980.meaning1: having stood; having stayed; having remained

examples.text: diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, ete ca nissāya vimānadassī, vinicchaye ṭhatvā pahassamāno, bālo paro akusalo'ti c'āha.

brahmakāyikānaṃ, bhikkhave, devānaṃ kappo āyuppamāṇaṃ. tattha puthujjano yāvat'āyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayam'pi gacchati tiracchānayonim'pi gacchati pettivisayam'pi gacchati.

28981.meaning1: (of an idea) having persisted (in); having continued to think (that)

examples.text: mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena yāva dvārakosā aggaḷaṭṭhapanāya ālokasandhiparikammāya dvatticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ appaharite ṭhitena adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ
udakaṃ āsanena ca, āsanena saha pāṇīyaparibhojaṇīyaṃ udakaṭṭhapanaṃ kataṃ kiṃ? āsanena saha pāṇīyaparibhojaṇīyaṃ udakaṭṭhapanaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

28986.meaning2: sake of establishing; purpose of laying out

28987.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from ṭhapeti, caus (+acc)

28989.meaning1: should be set aside; should be placed aside; should be left alone

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, pañho ek'aṃsavyākaraṇīyo, atthi, bhikkhave, pañho vibhajjavyākaraṇīyo, atthi, bhikkhave, pañho paṭipucchāvyākaraṇīyo, atthi, bhikkhave, pañho ṭhapanīyo

sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ek'aṃsena byākaroti, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na vibhajja byākaroti, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na paṭipucchā byākaroti, ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ṭhapeti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

28992.meaning2: leaves aside; puts aside; sets aside

examples.text: sakkā, bho gotama. imesañ'hi, bho gotama, pañcannaṃ aṅgānaṃ vaṇṇaṃ ṭhapayāma. kiñ'hi vaṇṇo karissati?

28993.meaning1: appointed; established; set up; placed in a position

28996.meaning1: having had placed; having had arranged

examples.text: nagaravīthiyo sodhāpetvā puṇṇaghaṭe ṭhapāpetvā dhajapaṭāk'ādayo ussāpetvā sakalanagaraṃ devavimānaṃ viya alaṅ'karonti.

28997.meaning1: caused to be placed; caused to be arranged

examples.text: rājā pasanno aparāni'pi pañca vatthasatāni āharāpetvā therassa pādamūle ṭhapāpesi.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakamaṇiko ādhāre ṭhapito pūro udakassa samatittiko kākapeyyo. tam'enaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āvajjeyya, āgaccheyya udakan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
ekassa paccekabuddhassa jātassaraṃ oruyha nhāyantassa tīre ṭhapitesu kāsāvesu cīvaraṃ thenetvā tesaṃ hatthīnaṃ gaman'āgamanamagge sattiṃ gahetvā sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisīdati
atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ udak'āvasesaṃ udak'ādhāne ṭhapetvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, passasi no tvaṃ, rāhula, imaṃ parittaṃ udak'āvasesaṃ udak'ādhāne ṭhapitan'ti?
